title: [29.x][Bug Fix] Fix recurring journal background posting for IRS 1099 invoice lines (US)
summary: IRS 1099 subscribers no longer call Modify(true) on journal lines during validation, allowing background recurring posting to succeed without re-entering OnModify and triggering posting failure checks.
key_points: Removed redundant SaveChangesInGenJnlLine calls that caused Modify(true) to re-fire OnModify during background posting
IRS field derivation still occurs but the owning caller now handles persistence
OnModify guard still protects against user edits while background posting works correctly
Added comprehensive tests validating scheduled posting works with IRS data sync and direct Modify still fails as expected
No schema, permission, or upgrade impact
quote: The subscriber only derives the IRS fields onto the record and lets the owning caller persist.
